        var FALLBACK_CDN = "https://assets.mattermost.com/staging";
        var CDN_ROOT = "https://assets.mattermost.com";

          if (base && bases.indexOf(base) === -1) bases.push(base);
        });

        function assetPath(url) {
          if (!url) return null;
          var abs;
          try {
            abs = new URL(url, location.href);
          } catch (e) {

          }

          var el = event.target;
          if (!el || el.tagName !== "IMG") return;
          if (active) retry(el);
          else pending.push(el);
        }

          if (active) return;
          active = true;

  </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/secure-messaging.jpg" alt="Mattermost Flight Planning channel with a dust storm briefing at Al Udeid" width="1024" height="763" loading="eager" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-1" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Workflow automation  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>Repeatable playbooks for incident response, change management, and compliance, with conditional checklists, SLA timers, and escalation.   </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/workflow-automation.jpg" alt="Mattermost playbook run for Incident-765A with an incident task checklist" width="1024" height="763" loading="lazy" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-2" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Human-machine teaming  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>Sovereign AI agents summarise, enrich alerts, and take action using the LLM provider you choose, or a self-hosted model in air-gapped environments. Agents can hand tasks to other agents through the open API, with human-machine teaming built into every workflow.</p>
  </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/human-machine-teaming.jpg" alt="Mattermost Pacific Response Ops thread where an AI agent summarizes a maritime security incident" width="1024" height="763" loading="lazy" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-3" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-3" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Audio & screenshare  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>Calls and screen sharing inside any channel, on your own calls server, with live transcription and AI summaries.</p>
  </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/audio-screenshare.jpg" alt="Mattermost call with nine participants, two raised hands, and host controls" width="1024" height="763" loading="lazy" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-4" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-4" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Federation & interoperability  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>Shared messages and files across federated Mattermost servers over secure links, standards-compatible for coalition operations.   </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/federation.jpg" alt="Mattermost channel settings sharing Release Planning with a connected workspace" width="1024" height="763" loading="lazy" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-5" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-5" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Classified information control  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>Classification banners and labels, dynamic attribute-based access control (ABAC), timed message expiry, and burn-on-read to contain data spillage. Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) compatible. FIPS 140-3 validated, STIG-hardened images.</p>
  </div> </div>  </div> <div class="cs-shot"> <img src="https://assets.mattermost.com/images/home/capabilities/classified-controls.jpg" alt="Mattermost Operation Aurora channel with an unclassified banner and limited access rules" width="1024" height="763" loading="lazy" decoding="async"> </div> </div><div class="cs-panel" id="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-panel-6" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="e9b6eee8-dda4-4766-abd8-ce19067bc1bd-tab-6" hidden data-cs-panel> <div class="cs-copy"> <h3 class="heading"> <span class="heading-inner size-lg align-start">  <span class="heading-text">  Integration framework  </span>  </span> </h3>  <div class="text cs-description" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a> <div class="text-inner align-start" data-astro-cid-r4icev6a>  <p>A REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, incoming and outgoing webhooks, slash commands, and interactive dialogs. Prebuilt and custom integrations cover operations, security, and DevSecOps tools, backed by an extensible, audited, and hardened open-source supply chain.</p>
